response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment (hospitalization and examinations) resulting from a head injury (otřes mozku) during a trip. Clause A4.1 covers medical expenses abroad for acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing (A5.1), intentional (A11.1), caused by alcohol (A11.2), or related to extreme sports (A11.3), and the policy explicitly includes extreme sports. Therefore, the claim is covered under A4.1."}
